_doc.backend: PoC harness adapter: openhands, codex, claude, or deepseek_harness. The launcher delegates harness-specific command construction to reward_framework.adapters.poc_generation.
_doc.model: Model the subject generates with. OpenHands/Codex GPT runs use ModelHub-compatible settings; Claude and DeepSeek use their adapter/provider environment.
_doc.base_url: Optional provider base URL. For OpenHands this is passed to LiteLLM; for Codex GPT ModelHub runs it is bridged from Responses to ModelHub chat completions; for Claude/DeepSeek it becomes the provider base URL env.
_doc.api_key_env: Optional environment or repo config.txt variable containing the API key. Never put the secret itself in this JSON. Defaults by model family.
_doc.api_version: Optional API version forwarded to adapters that support it.
_doc.results_namespace: Required model-specific directory name under poc_results/. This prevents one model run from overwriting another.
_doc.max_iter: Iteration cap per episode. The prompt requires final analysis.json; OpenHands capture allows a tool-free finalization turn at the cap.
_doc.max_attempts: Re-run an episode up to this many times if it dies before a normal endpoint and produces no final analysis artifact.
_doc.openhands_repo: Complete OpenHands checkout to execute. Leave empty only when external/OpenHands itself is a complete checkout.
_doc.parallel: Max samples generated concurrently. Each ARVO sample may hold Docker workspace/runtime resources.
_doc.tmp_root: Optional disk-backed temp root exported as TMPDIR to generation subprocesses. Use this instead of /tmp for parallel ARVO runs.
_doc.run_reachability_after_generation: When true, rerun_model_batches.py evaluates deduplicated submitted PoCs after generation and writes reachability_eval.json.
_doc.reachability_max_hits_per_event: Maximum GDB hits retained for each reachability checkpoint.
_doc.samples: ARVO sample ids to generate PoCs for. Each writes poc_results/<results_namespace>/<sample_id>/ with manifest, submissions, checkpoint metadata, and analysis.json when produced.
_doc.skill_packet_dir: Do not set this in poc_generation baseline configs. Skill runs are isolated under reward_framework adapter entrypoints.
